reason: Authorise preregistered P4 Stage 1 after the formal availability gate passed: 3 exploratory blocks available; P4-HOLD publication metadata covers 101/101 archive days with 2409/2409 rows surviving under the preregistered coverage rule; coverage semantic hash 2330decb5beb676380b06b2b6a2d867700b5ca0de083332bb25fa5cf7dfdd8c6. This authorises Stage 1 fitting only and does not open or spend P4-HOLD.
note: P4's stage-1 machinery is implemented and its inputs are frozen; no P4 model has been fitted. This file is the interlock. `nn.p4_stage1` refuses to fit anything while `state` is not exactly "authorised", and flipping it is a commit rather than a flag, so beginning a P4 fit is a reviewable diff with a name and a reason attached to it. The runner requires a second, independent confirmation at the command line as well, so a Make target or a script cannot start a fit on its own. `preregistration_hash` must equal `nn.p4_preregistration.preregistration_hash()` at the moment of the run: an authorisation granted under one design does not carry over to an edited one. Authorising stage 1 is not authorising stage 2 — P4-HOLD is a separate one-shot gate in `nn.p4_holdout`, and nothing here opens it. `preregistration_hash` has been rebound four times, each time to keep this file bound to the active design: by source-protocol amendment A1 (docs/p4_preregistration.md §3.4a), which added open_interest_duplicate_policy to the hashed payload, by amendment A2 (§3.4b), which added funding_archive_inception_policy to it, by amendment A3 (§3.4c), which added perpetual_kline_archive_inception_policy to it, and by amendment A4 (§3.4d), which added open_interest_observation_validity_policy to it. The state remained not_authorised through all four amendments: rebinding this file to the active design granted nothing, and no P4 fit was run under this hash or any superseded hash before this authorisation. The formal availability gate has now passed and this commit authorises only preregistered P4 Stage 1 fitting; it does not authorise or spend P4-HOLD. Only the active hash is recorded here — the superseded values are historical provenance and live in docs/p4_preregistration.md, which is where the amendments are explained.
